controller.parameter_provenance: Sensitivity scenario: inertias scaled by 1.2; URDF inertias; nominal, not hardware calibrated
controller.timing: Consecutive fixed-period ticks starting at zero; zero-order hold; no extrapolation
controller.continuous_joints: Unwrapped coordinates supplied by the reference and measurement

run.runtime_scope: backend initialization, controller, RK4, state checks and logging; excludes metrics/export
assumptions: fixed base, rigid serial chain, ideal joint effort actuators
no contact, collision, joint-stop impulses, sensor noise or latency
deterministic; no random seed or measurement noise used

metrics.settling_definition: First controller sample after move_end followed only by samples within the position band to run end, with at least steady_window seconds observed; finite horizon
metrics.overshoot_definition: Peak beyond final reference in move direction, divided by reference displacement; zero-displacement joints are null
metrics.sample_scope: Uniform controller-rate samples; per-joint quantities retain rad/m and are not pooled across unlike units
